# Modern Java Best Practices Plugin ### Modern Java 21+ Language Idioms, Screaming Clean Architecture & DOP [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Plugin%20v1.0.0-4F46E5.svg)](https://antigravity.google) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-10B981.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-halcyontech.com.br-008080.svg)](https://www.halcyontech.com.br/) [![Organization](https://img.shields.io/badge/Organization-HalcyonTech--LTDA-black.svg)](https://github.com/HalcyonTech-LTDA)

Modern Java best practices, idioms, Object-Oriented & Data-Oriented Programming, stable Virtual Thread concurrency, Screaming Clean Architecture, deterministic testing, and high-performance Gradle build conventions (Modern Java Standard Baseline).

--- ## Installation & Verification ### Antigravity CLI (`agy`) Install directly into your Antigravity environment via the CLI: ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/HalcyonTech-LTDA/modern-java-best-practices ``` Verify that the plugin is active and adheres to the strict official schema: ```bash agy plugin list agy plugin validate --strict ./modern-java-best-practices ``` --- ## Production-Strict Policy This plugin adheres strictly to **100% finalized and standardized Java language features and APIs**. It does not generate, recommend, or require preview flags (`--enable-preview`) in production code. --- --- ## What's Included (Component Catalog) ### Contextual Rules (`rules/`) Automatically loaded to govern and protect project contexts: - **[`modern-java-engineering.md`](rules/modern-java-engineering.md)**: Automatically enforces modern Java 21+ baseline standards, Screaming Clean Architecture, Data-Oriented Programming (records, pattern matching), strict anti-Lombok policy, Loom concurrency, deterministic testing, and Gradle Kotlin DSL build conventions. ### Procedural Skills (`skills/`) On-demand actionable workflows and runbooks: - **[`/modern-gradle-conventions`](skills/modern-gradle-conventions/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when configuring, refactoring, or optimizing Gradle builds for modern Java projects (Modern Java Standard Baseline): exclusive Kotlin DSL (.gradle.kts), Convention Plugins via composite builds (build-logic), Version Catalogs (libs.versions.toml), dependency discipline (api vs implementation, BOMs, bundles), Java Toolchains, Configuration Cache, JVM Test Suites, parallel test execution, Jacoco, Pitest mutation testing, and Groovy-to-Kotlin DSL migration. - **[`/modern-java-clean-architecture`](skills/modern-java-clean-architecture/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when architecting, implementing, or refactoring Java services using Screaming Architecture, Clean Architecture, OOP and Data-Oriented Programming (DOP): feature-first package structure, cross-feature communication, pure domain models, framework-free application layer, rich OOP entities, Value Objects with records, sealed domain event and error types (Result), inbound/outbound ports (Ports & Adapters), and framework-agnostic interactors. - **[`/modern-java-concurrency`](skills/modern-java-concurrency/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when designing, implementing, or optimizing multi-threaded, concurrent, or asynchronous Java applications: Virtual Threads per-task model, task orchestration with CompletableFuture and Virtual Thread executors, workload separation (I/O vs CPU), and diagnosing/preventing carrier thread pinning. - **[`/modern-java-idioms`](skills/modern-java-idioms/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when writing, modernizing, or refactoring Java code to utilize modern Java language features (Modern Java Standard Baseline): Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) & SOLID principles, Data-Oriented Programming (DOP), Records and Record Patterns, exhaustive switch expressions, Sealed Hierarchies, Unnamed Variables and Patterns, Sequenced Collections, Flexible Constructor Bodies, Stream Gatherers, Dependency Hygiene (Anti-Lombok), and the Foreign Function & Memory (FFM) API. - **[`/modern-java-testing`](skills/modern-java-testing/SKILL.md)**: Use this skill when designing, writing, or optimizing automated tests in Java (Modern Java Standard Baseline): Clean Architecture test pyramid, In-Memory Fakes over Mocks, integration testing with Testcontainers and @ServiceConnection, API testing with RestAssured, anti-flakiness with Awaitility and Clock injection, mutation testing with Pitest, test data generation with Instancio, JUnit Jupiter patterns (@Nested, @TempDir, @Tag), AssertJ, and architectural fitness rules with ArchUnit. --- ## Directory Hierarchy ```text modern-java-best-practices/ ├── plugin.json # Official Antigravity manifest (schema v1) ├── LICENSE # MIT License (Copyright 2026 HalcyonTech LTDA) ├── .gitignore # System ignores & installed_version.json exclusions ├── .gitattributes # Deterministic line endings (* text=auto eol=lf) ├── README.md # Golden Standard documentation & runbook ├── assets/ │ ├── logo.svg # Antigravity marketplace square icon │ └── halcyon-horizontal-cor.svg # Official Halcyon Tech brand logo (white background) # Official Halcyon Tech corporate vector symbol ├── rules/ # Contextual rules discovered automatically │ └── modern-java-engineering.md ├── skills/ # Actionable procedural skills (Progressive Disclosure) │ └── modern-gradle-conventions/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── modern-java-clean-architecture/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── modern-java-concurrency/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── modern-java-idioms/ │ └── SKILL.md │ └── modern-java-testing/ │ └── SKILL.md ``` --- ## 💡 Prompt Recipes & Use Cases ```markdown - "Refactor this Java service to modern Java 21+ idioms and Data-Oriented Programming" - "Implement Screaming Clean Architecture with pure domain models and sealed hierarchies" - "Configure deterministic unit and integration tests using Testcontainers" ``` --- ## 📄 License & Corporate Governance Distributed under the **MIT License**.
